main.description: Anything with a place in a context's tree: a folder, a page, a file, a motion, an amendment, an election, a candidacy, a question, and the place of a poll or a canvas (whose ballots and cells are never records). One record type with a `kind`, as the backend has one table: what differs between kinds is who may make them where, which is a rule of the application and not a shape. Keyed by the node's id, so that its address survives a rename and a move.

slug.description: Its segment of the path, unique among the live nodes under its parent.

parent.description: The node it sits in, in this space. Absent directly under the context.

index.description: Its place among its siblings, where someone set one.

draft.description: Not submitted yet: its author's to change, and listed to nobody else.

locked.description: Nothing new may be put under it (no further amendments, no further candidates).

content.description: Its text, in the format `contentFormat` names.

contentBlob.description: The body, in place of `content`, where it is past what a PDS takes inside one record: the same JSON, as a file.

data.description: Whatever else the kind keeps beside its text. A file is named in it by its id (`fileId`, `image`), which is the key of a `wiki.radikal.file` in the same wiki.

madeBy.description: The account that made it, when the record is held by the organization for them: a DID, or a carried account's id.

legacyId.description: Its id in the interim, for what was carried over.
